name: Erias Eversharp
description: Erias Eversharp is an energetic and talkative half-elven apprentice working alongside Tally Fellbranch at The Bent Nail. Named for his knack for keeping hand saws, chisels, and carving blades razor-sharp, he is enthusiastic, quick with a joke, and always eager to try out bold new woodworking designs.
ideals: Innovation: 'Tradition is great, but a well-sharpened blade and a fresh idea can build something truly extraordinary.'
Energy: 'Keep the saws buzzing and the shop lively; work goes twice as fast when you're having fun.'
bonds: The Bent Nail workshop and his fellow apprentice, Elaim.
The community of Trollskull Alley and the local adventurers.
flaws: Impulsive and easily distracted by experimental carving ideas, occasionally rushing through prep work.
speech_patterns: Upbeat, chatty, and enthusiastic, often tossing in cheerful commentary while he works.
mannerisms: Passes sharpening stones rhythmically across chisel edges, flashes bright grins at customers, and gestures animatedly when discussing custom designs.
motivations: To design his own line of custom wooden goods and prove his skills to Tally and the neighborhood.
knowledge: Tool sharpening and maintenance, rough timber cutting, workshop banter, and local alley gossip.
gm_notes: Erias brings vibrant energy to The Bent Nail. He can be used to pass along neighborhood rumors, eagerly pitch custom wood projects to the party, or add a lively, welcoming atmosphere to the workshop.
